question.worked_solution:
Squaring a complex number means to multiply it by itself, i.e.,

$$
(2+7\,\text{i})^{2}=(2+7\,\text{i})(2+7\,\text{i})
$$

Multiplying two complex numbers is similar to multiplying two binomials. We also use the fact that ${\text{i}}^{2}=-1.$

For the given problem, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}(2+7\,\text{i})^{2} & =(2+7\,\text{i})(2+7\,\text{i}) \\  & =2\cdot 2+2\cdot 7\,\text{i}+7\,\text{i}\cdot 2+7\,\text{i}\cdot 7\,\text{i} \\  & =4+14\,\text{i}+14\,\text{i}+49\,{\text{i}}^{2} \\  & =4+28\,\text{i}+49\cdot (-1) \\  & =4+28\,\text{i}-49 \\  & =-45+28\,\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$
